name: number_words
description: Convert a single decimal digit into its English cardinal word, versus copying a word tag in matched records.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
words=['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
    d=i%10; tag=random.choice(['red','blue','green','gold','white','black']); name=random.choice(['A','B','C','D'])
    p='Record '+name+': digit='+str(d)+'; tag='+tag+'.\n'
    items.append({'prompt':p+'Write the digit as an English word:','answer':' '+words[d]})
    control.append({'prompt':p+'Write the tag as an English word:','answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
